scene_analysis.scene_overview: A bathroom with a large window and a white bathtub on the left side. The room has beige walls and a white ceiling. There is a wooden cabinet with shelves and drawers on the right side of the room. A towel is rolled up on top of the shelf. The floor is made of white tile. The window has a view of a tall building outside. The room is well-lit.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building across the street is taller than the one inside. It has a flat roof and a balcony. The building is made of concrete and has a modern design. The building is painted white.
scene_analysis.materials: The bathtub is made of white porcelain. The shower head is silver. The faucet is also silver.
